max: Quick pre-freeze handoff — change window in ~30m (22:00 PT). Posting minimal readiness checklist, reply with OK or issues.

deploy-bot: Automated: change window scheduled 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z. Pin action: model-service -> v2.1.3 (prod). Canary policy: 10% traffic for 20m then ramp. Ref: release/3678.

ana: typo? Ana: I can take the canary health watch. Rolling smoke should be < 10m.

ana: Also, quick note — migration: none, config flags: `enable_experimental_routing=false`.

kiran: Confirming pin: `api-model: v2.1.3` pinned, fallback `api-model: v2.0.9` available. Suggest ramp strategy: 10 -> 30 -> 60 -> 100 over 20m. Embeddings budget capped.

ops-oncall: oncall here. Alert thresholds set: p95 > 200ms OR error_rate > 1% = pager. I will monitor first 15m.

max: Minimal smoke checklist: 1) deploy-bot canary initiated, 2) smoke tests green, 3) no DB migrations, 4) pin verified, 5) runbook up and rollback cmd ready.

ana: Running smoke now. Canary hit a rerank timeout on test 3. Collecting logs.

deploy-bot: Canary logs: node-3: `rerank timeout 12000ms`, KV cache warm on node-1/2, batcher connected. Progress 50%.

kiran: If rerank timeout persists, set fallback header for that route: `x-embed-fallback: true` to route to cpu-embed-tier until we fix model heat. Also increasing per-request timeout to 18s for canary.

ops-oncall: Rollback command staged in runbook: `./ops rollback --service model-service --to v2.0.9 --drain=true --notify=true`. I have escalation path documented.

max: Hold for 10 more minutes while ana retries. If smoke passes, we open window. If not, move to backup window at 23:00 PT.

ana: Retry passed. All smoke tests green and canary metrics stable. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Change window OPENED. Traffic shifted 10% -> canary. Metrics snapshot: p50=85ms p95=180ms errors=0.2%.

kiran: Noted. Tagging @security for KMS rotation visibility (no rotation in this change).

ops-oncall: I'll ramp to 100% over 20m and watch the dashboards. Will call if any spike.

max: Launch window confirmed open. I'll draft brief release notes and post to #announcements after 100% completion. Thanks team — standby for post-rollout check-in.
